name: AltSpace v2.3.0 — Smart Game Hub, Noise Filter & Modern Monochrome Control Plane
features: Smart Game Hub: Auto-discovery and 1-stroke launcher for Steam, Epic, Xbox Game Pass, and standalone titles
Intelligent Noise Filter: Excludes internal caches, logs, temp files, and extensions (.ink, .log, .tmp, etc.)
Developer Port Inspector: Terminate blocking developer ports (:3000, :8080) with a single keystroke
Everything SDK / MFT Integration: Sub-millisecond whole-drive indexing and search across all drives
Offline Developer Tools: Base64, UUID v4, SHA-256, JSON/YAML converter, and JWT debugger
fixes: Pro Trial banner simplified to trending 'Pro'/'Try Pro' indicator, hidden for licensed users and maintainers
Eliminated obsolete and clutter file extensions by default with granular settings toggles
Detached sidecar auto-updater engine eliminating file-lock stalls and API rate limits
